form.title: Title
form.slugHint: The last part of the address. Made from the title if left empty.
form.name: Name
form.seoFollows: Left empty, the template for this type of post decides.
form.breadcrumbHint: Instead of the title, when a shorter name fits better. The levels themselves follow from where the post sits.
form.headline: Main headline
form.workingNameHint: Shown in the lists of posts. The breadcrumb, and the slug of a new post, are made from it.
form.caption: Caption
form.libraryHint: Copied into a post when the image is chosen there, where it can then be changed for that use.
form.label: Label
form.labelHint: The post's title, if left empty.
form.otherPathHint: The path from the site's root, starting with /, such as /old-page/. Not a whole web address: the site can only answer at addresses of its own.
form.otherPathPattern: Write a path starting with /, such as /old-page/, not a whole web address.
form.urlHint: Only for an entry that does not lead to a post.
refusal.element-not-taken: this kind of post cannot hold {element}; take it out, or ask the site's developer to allow it
refusal.inline-element: the site cannot publish {inline} in {element}; take it out
refusal.soft-break: the site cannot keep a line break made by a plain new line; join the lines, or make it a line break of its own
refusal.raw-html: the site cannot publish the raw HTML {tag}; use the editor's own formats
refusal.raw-unclosed: the raw HTML <{tag}> is never closed; close it, or use the editor's own formats
refusal.construct: the site cannot publish this: Markdown calls it {type}; take it out
refusal.constructs.thematicBreak: the site cannot publish a separator; take it out
refusal.constructs.linkReference: the site cannot publish a link that names its address elsewhere; write it as [text](address)
refusal.constructs.imageReference: the site cannot publish an image that names its address elsewhere; add the image again
refusal.constructs.definition: the site cannot publish a link definition; write the address in the link itself
refusal.heading-level: the site cannot publish a heading at level {level}: the post's title is its level 1; use a level from {levels}
refusal.heading-empty: the site cannot publish a heading without text; write its text, or take it out
refusal.anchor-form: the site cannot publish the anchor "{anchor}": an anchor holds only a to z, digits, hyphens and underscores
refusal.anchor-place: an anchor stands first in a heading; move it there, or take it out
refusal.anchor-twice: block {block} has the anchor "{anchor}" too, and a link to it would land on the first; give each heading its own
refusal.anchor-taken: the site keeps the anchor "{anchor}" for its footnotes; give the heading another
refusal.list-start: the site cannot publish a numbered list that starts at {start}; start it at 1
refusal.list-loose: the site cannot publish a list with blank lines between its items; take the blank lines out
refusal.list-item-empty: the site cannot publish a list item without text; write its text, or take it out
refusal.list-item-blocks: a list item holds one paragraph, and a list under it at most; move the rest out of the list
refusal.quote-empty: the site cannot publish a quote without text; write its text, or take it out
refusal.quote-block: a quote cannot hold {block}; move it out of the quote
refusal.citation-place: a citation is a quote's last paragraph, wrapped whole in <cite>; move it there, or take it out
refusal.code-empty: the site cannot publish an empty code block; write its code, or take it out
refusal.table-row: row {row} of the table has {cells} cells and its header {columns}; give every row the header's number of cells
refusal.table-no-header: the site cannot publish a table without a header row; give it one
refusal.table-header-rows: the site cannot publish a table with more than one header row; make the others plain rows
refusal.table-header-plain: a table's header row holds header cells alone; make each cell in it a header cell
refusal.table-header-outside: a header cell stands in a table's header row alone; make the others plain cells
refusal.table-empty: the site cannot publish an empty table; give it its cells, or take it out
refusal.table-spans: row {row} of the table does not cover each of its columns once; check the merged cells
refusal.table-align: column {column} of the table is aligned differently in different rows; align the whole column alike
refusal.table-shape: the site cannot publish this table's HTML{tag}: it reads only a caption, a header, a body and a footer, with the formats bold, italic, link, superscript, subscript, code and strikethrough
refusal.table-cell-attribute: the site cannot publish the table cell {tag}: a cell takes colspan, rowspan and a text-align that aligns it to the left, the right or the middle
refusal.link-title: the site cannot publish a link with a title; take the title out
refusal.link-address: the site cannot link to {address}: a link leads to a path on the site, or to {schemes}
refusal.link-fragment: the site cannot link to {address} alone; link to the post and the anchor, as a path on the site
refusal.link-admin: the site cannot link to {address}, the host where editors sign in, which visitors never reach
refusal.image-alone: an image stands alone in its paragraph, with its caption after a line break; move the rest out
refusal.image-place: an image stands at the top of the body, or in a list's item, never in a quote; move it out
refusal.image-alt: the site cannot publish an image without alt text; describe the image
refusal.image-alt-lines: an image's alt text is one line; join its lines
refusal.image-link-alt: the site cannot publish a linked image without alt text; name where the link leads
refusal.image-title: the site cannot publish an image with a title; take the title out, or make it the caption
refusal.embed-place: an embed stands at the top of the body, never in a quote or a list; move it out
refusal.embed-caption: the site cannot show a caption with the embed {address}; take the caption out
refusal.directive-unknown: the site has no directive {name}; choose one it offers, or write the colons as \:
refusal.directive-form: the site writes the directive {name} as {form}
refusal.directive-label: the site cannot publish the directive {name} with a label; take it out
refusal.directive-attribute: the directive {name} takes no setting "{attribute}"; take it out
refusal.directive-value: the site cannot publish the setting "{attribute}" with the value "{value}"; choose another
refusal.footnote-twice: the footnote "{label}" is marked twice; give each mark a footnote of its own
refusal.footnote-unmarked: the footnote "{label}" has no mark in the text; mark it, or take it out
refusal.footnote-empty: the footnote "{label}" has no text; write its text, or take out the footnote and its mark
refusal.footnote-blocks: the footnote "{label}" holds more than one paragraph of text; make it one
refusal.footnote-place: a footnote's mark cannot stand in a link's text; move it out of the link
refusal.read-back: the site would read {element} otherwise than it is written, whatever is escaped; reword what looks like Markdown in it
refusal.source-frontmatter: the file does not start with its fields between two lines of ---; save the post again from the editing tool
refusal.source-yaml: the fields at the top of the file cannot be read ({detail}); save the post again from the editing tool
refusal.source-json: the file cannot be read as JSON ({detail}); save it again from the editing tool
refusal.status: a post is a draft, scheduled or published, not "{status}"; choose one
refusal.scheduled-date: a scheduled post needs its date and time; give it one, or make it a draft
refusal.language-folder: the folder {folder} is none of the site's languages, so the post cannot be published; move it to a language the site declares
refusal.admin-file: {by} is no Admin, and only an Admin may change {file}, so visitors still get the last version an Admin left; ask an Admin to save it
refusal.admin-legal: {by} is no Admin, and only an Admin may change a post chosen as a legal page, so visitors still see its last version; ask an Admin to save it
refusal.admin-legal-gone: {by} is no Admin, and only an Admin may take a post chosen as a legal page off the site, so visitors still see it; ask an Admin to restore it, or to choose another page in the settings
refusal.title-empty: the site cannot publish a post without a title; give it one
refusal.title-markup: the site cannot publish a title holding HTML; write it as plain text
refusal.slug: the site cannot use "{slug}" as a slug: a slug holds a to z in lowercase, digits, hyphens and underscores
refusal.slug-empty: the site cannot make a slug of this title; give the post a slug of a to z, digits and hyphens
refusal.field-required: the site cannot publish a post without its {field}; fill it in
refusal.field-moment: the site cannot publish "{value}" as a date and time in {field}; choose one
refusal.field-text: the site cannot publish this as {field}; write it as plain text
refusal.field-markup: the site cannot publish {field} holding HTML; write it as plain text
refusal.terms-most: a post takes at most {most} of its {plural}; choose fewer
refusal.image-required: the site cannot publish a post without its featured image; choose one, or keep the post as a draft
refusal.image-gone: the original of the image {name} is gone from the media library; upload it again, or choose another
refusal.image-outside: the site shows images from its media library, not {address}; upload the image, and choose it there
refusal.image-small: this image is {width} pixels wide, and the site takes none narrower than {smallest}; choose a larger one
refusal.image-moving: the site cannot show a moving image; choose a still JPEG, PNG or WebP, or a video
refusal.image-kind: the site cannot use {kind} as an image; save it as a JPEG, PNG or WebP, and upload that
refusal.image-large: this image is larger than the 30 MB the site takes; save it smaller, and upload it again
refusal.image-pointer: the file holds a pointer to the image rather than the image, so the build could not fetch it; save the post again, or tell whoever runs the site
refusal.icon-square: the site icon must be square; choose a square image
refusal.icon-small: the site icon is {width} pixels wide, and must be at least 512, or an SVG; choose a larger one
refusal.svg: the site cannot show this SVG, which holds {what}; save it without that, and upload it again
refusal.seo-shape: the site cannot read the search and sharing fields; save the post again from the editing tool
refusal.seo-flag: the search and sharing field {key} is on or off; turn it on, or leave it out
refusal.seo-text: the search and sharing field {key} is plain text; fill it in, or leave it out
refusal.seo-schema: the site cannot use "{value}" as a structured data type; choose one of {types}
refusal.seo-image-alt: a sharing image comes with its alt text, and alt text with its image; fill in both, or neither
refusal.other-shape: the site cannot read the other addresses; save the post again from the editing tool
refusal.other-address: the site cannot use "{address}" as an other address: it is a path as a browser sends it, starting with a slash
refusal.other-answer: the other address {address} cannot answer "{answer}": it answers 301, 302, 307, 308 or show
refusal.other-show-query: the site cannot show a post at {address}: a post is shown at a path without a query; answer with a redirect, or take the query out
refusal.other-no-address: {plural} have no page of their own, so they take no other addresses; take them out
refusal.other-held: the address {address} belongs to "{holder}"; choose another
refusal.other-rule: the site's redirect rules hold the address {address}; choose another, or ask an Admin to remove the rule
refusal.term-main: the term "{term}" has no file in the main language, {language}; save it there first
refusal.term-name: the term {term} has no name; give it one
refusal.term-markup: the site cannot publish the term "{term}", whose name or description holds HTML; write them as plain text
refusal.term-slug: the site cannot use "{slug}" as the slug of the term "{term}": a slug holds a to z in lowercase, digits, hyphens and underscores
refusal.term-language: the term "{term}" has a file in the folder {folder}, which is none of the site's languages; remove it
refusal.term-differs: the term "{term}" has another description or parent in {language} than in the main language; a term's are the same in every language
refusal.term-parent: the parent of the term "{term}" is gone ({parent}); choose another
refusal.term-loop: the term "{term}" stands under itself; choose another parent
refusal.term-gone: the post names a term of its {plural} that no longer exists ({id}); choose another
refusal.reference-no-address: a reference leads to "{title}", and {plural} have no page of their own; choose another
refusal.reference-term: a reference leads to the term "{term}", and {plural} have no page of their own; choose another
refusal.parent-missing: the post's parent no longer exists ({parent}); choose another
refusal.parent-type: the post's parent "{parent}" is not one of its {plural}; choose another
refusal.parent-loop: the post stands under itself, through "{parent}"; choose another parent
refusal.parent-refused: the post's parent "{parent}" cannot be published, and its address depends on it; fix the parent first
refusal.address-held: the address {address} belongs to "{holder}"; change this post's slug or parent
refusal.address-reserved: the site keeps the address {address} for itself; change this post's slug
refusal.address-feed: the address {address} is {feed}; change this post's slug
refusal.address-search: the address {address} is the site's search page; change this post's slug
refusal.address-list: the address {address} is among the later pages of the list in "{holder}"; change this post's slug
refusal.address-term: the address {address} is the page of the term "{term}"; change this post's slug
refusal.set-twice: "{holder}" is this post's translation in the same language; a language holds one post of a set
refusal.setting-pattern: the site cannot use the line "{line}" as a pattern; correct it
refusal.setting-shape: the site cannot read this value; save the settings again from the editing tool
refusal.setting-required: the site needs this setting; fill it in
refusal.menu-shape: the site cannot read this entry; save the menu again from the editing tool
refusal.menu-url: the site cannot lead a menu to "{url}": an entry leads to a post, a path on the site, or http://, https://, mailto: or tel:
refusal.menu-title: the entry has no label; give it one, or choose a post
refusal.menu-nowhere: the entry "{title}" leads nowhere and holds nothing; give it an address, or take it out
refusal.rule-shape: the site cannot read this rule; save the rules again from the Redirects page
refusal.rule-pattern-post: the pattern {pattern} cannot lead to a post by ID; give it an address as its target
refusal.rule-pattern-long: a pattern holds at most {most} characters; shorten it
refusal.rule-twice: another rule has the source {source}; remove one of them
refusal.rule-patterns: the site takes at most {most} patterns; remove some
refusal.rule-source: the site cannot use "{source}" as a source: it is a path as a browser sends it, starting with a slash
refusal.rule-reserved: the site keeps the address {source} for itself; a rule cannot answer there
refusal.rule-parameters: the source {source} holds more than {most} query parameters; shorten it
refusal.rule-status: the rule from {source} cannot answer "{status}": it answers {statuses}
refusal.rule-target: the rule from {source} cannot answer so: {reason}
refusal.rule-loop: the rule from {source} leads back to itself, so it would never answer; change its target
refusal.list-direction: the site cannot publish a list in the direction "{value}": a list is ascending or descending
refusal.list-offset: the site cannot publish a list that skips {value} posts: a list skips none, or a whole number of them
refusal.list-number: the site cannot publish a list of {value} posts: a list shows 1 to 100 posts
refusal.form-name: the site declares no form "{value}"; it declares {declared}
refusal.link-target: the site cannot publish a link that opens anywhere but a new tab (target "{value}")
refusal.link-rel: the site cannot publish a link with the rel value "{value}"; a link's rel may hold {words}, each once
refusal.embed-host: the site cannot embed content from {host}; it embeds content from {services}
refusal.embed-address: the site cannot embed the address "{address}"
refusal.embed-youtube: the site cannot embed this address from YouTube; use the address of a video or a playlist, such as https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=…, with no parameter but a start time (t)
refusal.embed-vimeo: the site cannot embed this address from Vimeo; use the address of a video, such as https://vimeo.com/…
refusal.embed-screen9: the site cannot embed this address from Screen9; use the address in the video's embed code, such as https://qcnl.tv/e/…
refusal.embed-loom: the site cannot embed this address from Loom; use the address of a video, such as https://www.loom.com/share/…
refusal.embed-spotify: the site cannot embed this address from Spotify; use the address of a track, an episode, a show, an album, a playlist or an artist, such as https://open.spotify.com/track/…
refusal.embed-acast: the site cannot embed this address from Acast; use the address of an episode, such as https://shows.acast.com/…/episodes/…
refusal.embed-apple-podcasts: the site cannot embed this address from Apple Podcasts; use the address of a show or an episode, such as https://podcasts.apple.com/…/podcast/…/id…
refusal.embed-speaker-deck: the site cannot embed this address from Speaker Deck; use the address in the presentation's embed code, such as https://speakerdeck.com/player/…
refusal.embed-datawrapper: the site cannot embed this address from Datawrapper; use the address of a published chart, such as https://datawrapper.dwcdn.net/…/
refusal.embed-codepen: the site cannot embed this address from CodePen; use the address of a pen, such as https://codepen.io/…/pen/…
refusal.embed-linkedin: the site cannot embed this address from LinkedIn; use the address of a public post, such as https://www.linkedin.com/posts/…
refusal.list-paged-twice: the site cannot publish a second list with pages of its own; turn off Pages in one of them
refusal.list-type: the site has no post type {type} to list
refusal.list-presentation: the site has no presentation {presentation} for a list; {offered}
refusal.list-option-value: the site cannot publish the setting {option} with the value {value}
refusal.list-option-choice: the option {option} is one of {choices}, not {value}
refusal.list-terms: the setting {setting} names terms as taxonomy:term,term, one taxonomy after another, not as {value}
refusal.list-taxonomy: {plural} take no terms of the taxonomy {taxonomy}
refusal.list-taxonomy-twice: the setting {setting} names the taxonomy {taxonomy} twice
refusal.list-where: the setting "where" holds conditions as field=value, one after another with ";" between them, not as {value}
refusal.list-where-field: {plural} have no field {field} to filter on
refusal.list-where-operator: the field {field} is compared only with = and !=, not {operator}
refusal.list-where-choice: the field {field} is one of {choices}, not {value}
refusal.list-related: {plural} have no terms to relate by
refusal.list-related-direction: a related list is ranked by the terms its posts share, so it takes no direction
refusal.list-order: {plural} have no field {field} to order by
warning.code-language: the site shows a code block without a language, so "{language}" is left out
warning.image-narrow: the image {name} is {width} pixels wide, narrower than the {display} the site usually shows images at, so it may look soft
warning.term-translation: the term "{term}" has no name in {language}, so it shows the main language's
warning.list-term-gone: a post list names a {taxonomy} that no longer exists ({term}), so it is left out of the list
warning.link-gone: the site shows "{text}" without its link, since what it leads to no longer exists
warning.link-no-page: the site shows "{text}" without its link until "{title}" is published
warning.link-language: the link "{text}" leads to another language, though its target has a translation in this post's
warning.not-found-none: the post chosen for addresses not found cannot serve, so the site shows its plain text there; publish it, or choose another
warning.setting-no-page: the setting {setting} leads to "{title}", which has no page now, so it is left out until it does
warning.setting-translation: the setting leads to "{title}", which has no translation in {language}, so it leads to the chosen post
warning.menu-no-page: the menu leaves out "{title}" and the entries under it, since it has no page now; it comes back by itself
warning.rule-chain: the rule from {source} leads to another rule, so a visitor is sent on twice; point it straight at the end
warning.rule-start: the rule from {source} leads to the start page, which search engines may read as a page that is gone
warning.rule-post-off: the rule from {source} leads to what has no page now, so it does not answer until that is published
warning.rule-shadowed: the rule from {source} does not answer, since a post or a term's page is live at that address
warning.legal-missing: the site asks for consent, and has no {page} to link to; choose one among the legal pages
warning.publisher-missing: the site has no publisher's name, so the footer shows none of its details; give it one, or a title for the site
about.element.heading: a heading
about.directive-leaf: ::{name}, on a line of its own
about.kind-boolean: yes or no, true or false
about.svg-doctype: a document type with declarations of its own
about.svg-stylesheet: a stylesheet from outside the file
about.svg-animation: an animation that sets a reference or a handler
about.svg-proportions: no proportions: give it a viewBox, or a width and a height
failure.not-read: the source could not be read, so visitors still see the last version
failure.check-broke: the check of what was saved broke, so visitors still see the last version
failure.not-built: the site could not be built from it, so visitors still see the last version
failure.not-released: the new version of the site could not be put in place, so visitors still see the last version
failure.stopped: the build would take most of the site's posts off it, so it waits until the deletion is confirmed
